company.shortDescription: Propway is first bank embedded digital marketplace making real estate investments and purchasing seamless, simple and frictionless
company.description: Propway is the region’s first embedded property platform, revolutionizing the real estate market by enabling digital property purchases through seamless integration with banking apps. Propway offers a fully integrated banking and payments experience, empowering users to browse, buy, and finance properties directly from their mobile banking applications. By bridging the gap between banking and real estate, Propway is setting a new standard for convenience and accessibility in property transactions digitally.
